requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥3 years and current CBOT Corn COT observation
requirements.policy: CFTC public API; exact CORN futures-only disaggregated contract

requirements.requirement: daily/weekly CORN issuer shares or holdings
requirements.policy: lawful issuer publications only; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: monthly; ≥30 years of dated ONI history
requirements.policy: NOAA CPC official ONI; ENSO is context and cannot substitute for crop-region weather

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years for grain/USD regimes
requirements.policy: reuse one Federal Reserve/FRED semantic series across commodity profiles; no commodity-specific clone

requirements.requirement: daily; ≥3 years of BRL, ARS and UAH against USD
requirements.policy: primary central-bank or lawful market history with exact FX bases; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current front-month CBOT Corn futures quote
requirements.policy: reuse the swarm pulse quote transport (`@C.1`); label it US¢/bu futures; no connector clone

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT Corn close history with source identity
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@C.1`; continuous back-adjusted futures

requirements.requirement: point-in-time CBOT Soybeans close history aligned to corn
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@S.1`; the corn/soybean ratio is one acreage cluster

requirements.requirement: point-in-time WTI close history aligned to corn
requirements.policy: reuse lawful shared market history for `@CL.1`; crude is an ethanol-demand confirmation, not corn itself

requirements.requirement: current old-crop/new-crop CBOT settlements with ≥3 years of curve snapshots
requirements.policy: CME official or licensed settlements with exact contracts; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current US interior/Gulf, Brazil and Argentina basis net of FX and freight
requirements.policy: primary AMS/customs/port data or licensed assessments with location and grade; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: monthly; current point-in-time US and world supply/use tables
requirements.policy: USDA WAOB official XML; revisions retained; production cells are bridge inputs and cannot cast a second demand vote

requirements.requirement: quarterly/monthly; ≥10 years of on-farm/off-farm stocks and stocks-to-use
requirements.policy: USDA NASS/WASDE primary data; reconcile quarterly stocks to the balance and preserve revisions

requirements.requirement: weekly in season; ≥10 years by state
requirements.policy: USDA NASS and equivalent primary crop reports with release vintage; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current plus ≥30 years of daily yield-weighted weather aligned to planting/pollination/grain fill
requirements.policy: primary meteorological observations/forecasts with geography, model run and expiry; otherwise unavailable

requirements.requirement: current US, Brazil, Argentina and Ukraine acreage/yield/output with dispersion
requirements.policy: USDA, CONAB and other primary crop releases; do not duplicate WASDE balance signals

requirements.requirement: weekly; ≥5 market years of sales, reductions/adjustments and shipments by destination
requirements.policy: USDA FAS primary data; preserve China as a destination and separate gross sales, net sales and physical shipment

requirements.requirement: weekly/monthly physical ethanol output, stocks and corn grind plus margin inputs
requirements.policy: EIA/USDA primary data; policy or crude-price moves are context and cannot replace physical grind

requirements.requirement: current dated mandates, credits and blend-rule changes
requirements.policy: primary regulator publications with effective date and expiry; policy cannot cast a physical-demand vote

requirements.requirement: current export restrictions, port capacity and verified rerouting
requirements.policy: primary government, customs and port evidence; start from pre-policy supply and do not recount production

requirements.requirement: current marginal farm cash-cost and feed/ethanol/export-parity range
requirements.policy: primary farm budgets/input prices and lawful physical values; separate observed price, model range and market expectation
